**Step: To select the best performing value of the regularization hyperparameter via 8-fold CV, how many times must each data point be used in the training dataset of a fitted model?**

**Hint 1:** In an 8-fold cross-validation, the dataset is divided into $$8$$ parts. For each fold, one part is used as the validation set, and the remaining $$7$$ parts are used as the training set. Consider how many times each data point is included in the training set across all folds.

**Hint 2:** Since there are $$11$$ different values of the hyperparameter being tested, each data point will be used in the training set for each of these values. Calculate the total number of times each data point is used in the training set by considering both the number of folds and the number of hyperparameter values.
